description: List dentists, eye care practices, vets, dermatology or GI practices in a ZIP code, city or state, optionally filtered by ownership label. With industry "brand", list consumer brands instead (no location needed), filtered by label and by words in the brand, owner, backer or category (name), e.g. pet food brands with no known PE ties. Covers requests like "dentists in Plano, TX with no PE ties" (label=no_known_pe_ties) or "PE-backed eye doctors in 75024" (label=pe_backed,lender_owned). Labels: pe_backed, lender_owned (PE-backed, now lender-controlled), corporate_owned (not PE, owned by a company), health_system_owned, group_practice (owned by its dentists/doctors, no outside investor), vc_backed, no_known_pe_ties, unconfirmed, not_labeled; aliases pe and no_pe. Returns counts by label for the area, total, a page of results (limit up to 100, then next_offset) with each one's label wording and source, and the coverage note. Dental and eye care cover every NPI-registered practice; vet, derm and GI list only the tracked groups' locations. Some listings come from clinicians' individual NPI records and aren't confirmed open.

industry.description: dental (default), eye, vet, derm, gi, or brand (consumer brands).

label.description: One or more labels, comma-separated, e.g. "no_known_pe_ties" or "pe_backed,lender_owned".

name.description: Only businesses whose name contains these words. For brands, words in the brand, owner, backer or category (e.g. "pet food", "Sycamore Partners").

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name. Needed with city unless the city name is unique.

name: find_businesses
title: Find businesses in an area by ownership
